scene_summary: I sit aboard a ferry cabin during sunset, looking out the window at the sea, holding hands with my companion, and remarking on an annoying cable.
activity_chain: look out cabin window, look down at hands, look across cabin, speak to companion

segments.action: I sit in my seat on the ferry, looking out through the windows at the sea and the evening sky during sunset, with the cabin TV screen displaying safety audio files in view.
segments.environment: Physical space: Interior passenger cabin of a ferry boat with warm ceiling lights, a large square ceiling light fixture, patterned floor tiles, and a white exit door on the left with a window and door handle. Objects: A long white curved counter extends beneath double glass windows overlooking the dusk seascape; grey curtains hang beneath the counter; a blue cloth rests on the left counter. Displays: A large wall-mounted TV screen on the right displays a blue media player interface showing '< 返回', folders '1、海事部门安全要求' and '2、提醒旅客系好安全带', and highlighting '减速提示广播.mp3'. Text: Wall and cabinet stickers reading '垃圾投入口', '主逃生路线 PRIMARY ESCAPE ROUTE', '禁止吸烟', '本区域已安装视频监视', and '扫码使用卫星WiFi'. People: A companion in a white shirt and black pants sits beside me to the right. Ambient audio: Continuous low hum of the ship engine.
text_visible: 主逃生路线 PRIMARY ESCAPE ROUTE
segments.details: My gaze shifts across the seascape visible through the cabin windows and the windowsill counter.
segments.revision_note: Enriched TV screen interface details with the exact button '< 返回' and highlighted file '减速提示广播.mp3'.

scene_summary: I sit in a ferry passenger cabin holding my smartphone in landscape orientation and watch a recorded travel video of a dock on a lake surrounded by mountains.
activity_chain: hold phone, dismiss control center, watch scenic video on smartphone

segments.action: I hold my iPhone and dismiss the iOS Control Center overlay showing '中国电信 5G', '中国移动', '未在播放', and '专注模式'.
segments.environment: I am seated inside a ferry cabin. In front of me are rows of blue and purple passenger seats with white headrest covers displaying ferry route advertisements ('九洲港/香洲港出发 珠海海岛随心达'), tray tables with safety brochures ('How to use the lifejacket 救生衣穿着法'), and satellite Wi-Fi instructions ('扫码使用卫星WiFi BlueSeajet-95'). To my left sits a companion wearing a white collared long-sleeve shirt with a cream-colored bag. I hold a black-cased iPhone showing the iOS Control Center overlay displaying network carriers ('中国电信 5G', '中国移动'), battery level ('80%'), media player widget ('未在播放'), and Focus mode ('专注模式') before dismissing it to return to landscape video playback.
segments.details: I hold the phone with both hands, tapping to return to the video playback interface.
segments.revision_note: Enriched with specific iOS Control Center text visible on screen: carrier names, battery level, playback status '未在播放', and '专注模式'.
